title: CLARET PUNCH
instructions: Slice three lemons, pour over one wineglassful of Jamaica rum, one glassful of strong green tea,  sugar to taste, one bottle of claret. Put in two or three cupfuls of well-pounded ice.  --CELESTINE EUSTIS.
